population.text: The safety analysis set included all randomized patients who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication or 1 dose of oral AD medication during the double-blind treatment phase.

span.text: The safety analysis set included all randomized patients who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication or 1 dose of oral AD medication during the double-blind treatment phase.

notes: The source matches the served counts: 120/126 for esketamine plus AD and 89/126 for AD plus placebo. Table 4 counts patients experiencing at least one adverse event, not the number of events. TEAEs are treatment-emergent adverse events during the double-blind phase. Esketamine 56 mg and 84 mg were flexible doses within one randomized arm, not separate randomized arms. The safety denominators also equal the stated randomized totals; the efficacy analysis set has a different esketamine denominator.
